The DGCA-quoted theory definitively rules out (C), which is wrong — DCS does not self-resolve at 10,000 ft.

This likely accounts for 20 minutes after sunset as civil twilight, but the answer given in the book is A.)

rewords.oldLine: Explanation: Mode 5 = glide slope deviation alert. Armed when: valid G/S signal + gear down + ≤1000 ft RA. Triggers when >1.3 dots below G/S. Note: the reference answer key shows b — which describes Mode 4B conditions (flaps/speed). The correct Mode 5 description is (d). This is a known numbering quirk in that question set — see Section 8 for Mode 5 details.
